svg.title: The patterns Amber apps run, on first use
svg.desc: Process-cold times, Mica::Regex against PCRE2 with JIT. Routes (16 cases): 2.5 times as fast, 227.77 µs vs 561.0 µs; Templates (4 cases): 2.6 times as fast, 192.2 µs vs 502.32 µs; Markdown (32 cases): 2.8 times as fast, 204.55 µs vs 567.11 µs; Logs (28 cases): 2.6 times as fast, 205.72 µs vs 535.44 µs; CSV (8 cases): 2.7 times as fast, 194.03 µs vs 527.85 µs; Contacts (8 cases): 2.1 times as fast, 283.05 µs vs 594.83 µs; Identifiers (8 cases): 2.9 times as fast, 189.31 µs vs 551.21 µs. All 104 cases: 2.6 times as fast.
